name: youtube-bubble-telescope
description: Chrome extension that monitors and visualizes YouTube homepage recommendations to help users understand their personalized recommendation patterns

scripts.build-extension: zip -r youtube-bubble-telescope-extension.zip manifest.json background.js popup.html popup.js content_script.js styles.css chart.js *.png *.svg -x '*.DS_Store'
scripts.dev: echo 'Load extension in Chrome: chrome://extensions/ -> Load unpacked -> Select this directory'

author: Simon Wisdom
